threads.name: The unrecognized treasure map
threads.note: The party is following a treasure map whose marked locations they do not recognize. Where the treasure lies is still unknown.

threads.name: Clurichen from the riverbanks
threads.note: Reginald warned of a trickster creature that comes into town from the riverbanks every night, up to no good. The danger stands on its own and is unaddressed.

threads.name: Eric the Reeve's dragon bounty
threads.note: Eric offered 1000 gold for the dragon's body (beat_16), and the party has not yet hunted it. Sir Phidipaldi's insult and glove-slap (beats 18-19) soured relations with the bounty-giver, but Eric never accepted the duel, so the duel is not a live thread of its own.

threads.name: Lady Hilda's offer to join the dragon hunt
threads.note: Hilda offered to join a party for money to take on the dragon, which gives this thread a stated purpose under the bounty. Sir Phidipaldi said they would speak to the Reeve and come back to take up her services.

threads.name: The missing shipments to Brandonsford
threads.note: Bentley's restocking shipment is a week overdue and its fate is unknown. Farmer Gill adds that nothing has come into town in months, so the question remains open.

threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's offer of hire
threads.note: Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for 100 gold a week, with refunds per allowed kill. Dr. Uriah said he would think about it, so the offer stands undecided.

threads.name: Shamus the mule
threads.note: Farmer Gill offered to sell Shamus for 100 gold, and Dunk asked about trading work for him. Dunk is sleeping in the barn to think the offer over, so it remains undecided.

threads.name: Warwick's lucky charms and paranoia
threads.note: Warwick the smith keeps adding lucky charms and growing more paranoid, and it is unclear why. Gill's guess that the charms ward off Ingrid leaves the question open.

threads.name: Warwick's mithril chain shirt
threads.note: Warwick displays a superb mithril chain shirt that he refuses to sell. It is a desirable item that a normal-sized party member could wear.

threads.name: Quinn's vanishing ale
threads.note: Quinn's stock disappears every night, and he suspects Bentley. Sir Phidipaldi agreed to stage a fake ale delivery for 100 gold to find out what happens, and that help is still owed.

standalone_beats.reason: Bentley banned Sir Phidipaldi from the Clumsy Fox for the night and sent him to the Golden Egg, which split the party's lodging.
